 The post  Meet LEANN: An Open-Source Vector Index that Shrinks a 60M-Chunk R
news.aiSummary: UC Berkeley has introduced LEANN, an open-source vector index that significantly reduces storage requirements for large-scale RAG systems. By storing a pruned graph and recomputing embeddings at query time, it achieves 90% recall accuracy comparable to HNSW while using only 4 GB of memory instead of 188 GB, though this comes with a trade-off of seconds-level search latency.
